sellOnModesyPage.title: Sell on Modesy
sellOnModesyPage.p1: At Modesy, we make it easy and hassle-free for you to sell your products to customers all over the world. Whether you are a professional seller or just looking to make some extra cash, Modesy provides you with the perfect platform to showcase your products and reach a wider audience.
sellOnModesyPage.p2: Our platform is designed to provide you with the tools and support you need to create a successful online business. With a user-friendly interface and powerful features, you can easily list your products, manage your inventory, and process orders.
sellOnModesyPage.p3: At Modesy, we understand that selling online can be a daunting task. That's why we offer a range of resources to help you succeed. From seller guides and tutorials to customer support and seller forums, we are committed to helping you grow your business and achieve your goals.
sellOnModesyPage.p4: With Modesy, you can sell a wide range of products, including fashion, beauty, home and garden, electronics, and more. Our platform is designed to provide you with maximum exposure and reach, so you can connect with customers from all over the world.
sellOnModesyPage.p5: Join the Modesy community today and start selling your products to a global audience. With our powerful platform and dedicated support team, the sky is the limit for your online business.

contactPage.title: Contact
contactPage.p1: We are here to help you with any questions, concerns, or feedback you may have about our platform. Whether you are a buyer or a seller, our team is dedicated to providing you with the best possible support. If you need assistance with an order, have questions about our platform, or simply want to provide feedback, please don't hesitate to contact us. You can reach us through our contact form, located on this page. Simply fill out the form with your details and a brief message, and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
contactPage.p2: Alternatively, you can also reach us through our social media channels or email. Our team is available to assist you with any questions or concerns you may have.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.p1: At Modesy, we're more than just a marketplace — we're a community of creators, sellers, and buyers who believe in the power of connection. Our mission is to empower individuals and businesses to reach their full potential by providing a seamless and secure platform for buying and selling products.
aboutPage.p2: Founded in 2022, Modesy has grown from a small startup into a thriving global marketplace. We connect millions of buyers and sellers across the world, offering everything from fashion and accessories to home goods, electronics, and digital products.
aboutPage.p3: We believe in transparency, trust, and innovation. Every feature we build is designed to make your experience as smooth as possible — from personalized recommendations to secure payments and easy returns. Our dedicated support team is always here to help you every step of the way.
aboutPage.p4: Whether you are a first-time shopper or an experienced seller, Modesy is here to help you succeed. Join us today and be part of a global community that is redefining the future of e-commerce.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.p1: Welcome to Modesy. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use our services.
termsPage.section1: To access certain features, you must create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities under your account. You must provide accurate, current, and complete information.
termsPage.section2: Buyers agree to pay the listed price plus any applicable shipping fees and taxes. Sellers agree to list accurate product descriptions, set fair prices, and fulfill orders promptly. Modesy reserves the right to remove listings that violate our policies.
termsPage.section3: All payments are processed securely through our payment partners. Modesy does not store your payment details. Transactions are subject to our payment partners' terms and conditions.
termsPage.section4: Returns and refunds are handled in accordance with our return policy. Buyers must request a return within the specified window. Sellers are responsible for accepting returns and processing refunds in a timely manner.
termsPage.section5: You may not use the platform for any unlawful purpose, impersonate others, post false or misleading information, infringe on intellectual property rights, or engage in any activity that disrupts the platform's functionality.
termsPage.section6: Modesy is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform. Our total liability is limited to the amount you have paid us in the 12 months preceding the claim.
termsPage.section7: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting. Your continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.p1: At Modesy, your privacy is our priority. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.
privacyPage.section1: We collect personal information you provide directly, such as name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and payment information. We also automatically collect certain technical data when you use our platform, including IP address, browser type, device information, and usage patterns.
privacyPage.section2: We use your information to process transactions, provide customer support, improve our services, send order updates and promotional communications (with your consent), detect and prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations.
privacyPage.section3: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our platform, processing payments, and delivering orders. These partners are contractually obligated to protect your data.
privacyPage.section4: We implement industry-standard security measures including SSL encryption, firewalls, and secure server infrastructure to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacyPage.section5: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You may also opt out of marketing communications at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact us through our support channels.
privacyPage.section6: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. For more details, please see our Cookie Policy.
privacyPage.section7: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@modesy.com or through our Contact page.

cookiePage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePage.p1: This Cookie Policy explains how Modesy uses cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our platform.
cookiePage.section1: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They help us remember your preferences, understand how you use our platform, and improve your experience.
cookiePage.section2: Essential Cookies: These are necessary for the platform to function properly. They enable core features like authentication, shopping cart, and secure checkout.
cookiePage.section2b: Performance Cookies: These help us understand how visitors interact with our platform by collecting anonymous usage data. This allows us to improve our services.
cookiePage.section2c: Functional Cookies: These remember your preferences, such as language, currency, and location settings, to provide a personalized experience.
cookiePage.section2d: Advertising Cookies: These are used to deliver relevant advertisements to you and measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns.
cookiePage.section3: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our platform.
cookiePage.section4: We may use third-party services (such as analytics providers and payment processors) that place their own cookies on your device. These cookies are subject to the respective third parties' privacy policies.
cookiePage.section5: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

helpPage.title: Help Center
helpPage.p1: Welcome to the Modesy Help Center. We are here to assist you with any questions or issues you may encounter while using our platform.
helpPage.faq1q: How do I create an account?
helpPage.faq1a: Click the 'Login' button at the top of the page, then select 'Register'. Fill in your details and follow the confirmation steps. You can also sign up using your Google account.
helpPage.faq2q: How do I place an order?
helpPage.faq2a: Browse products and add them to your cart. When you are ready, proceed to checkout, enter your shipping address, select a payment method, and confirm your order.
helpPage.faq3q: What payment methods do you accept?
helpPage.faq3a: We accept payments via credit/debit cards, PayPal, bank transfers, and various local payment methods depending on your region.
helpPage.faq4q: How do I track my order?
helpPage.faq4a: After your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email. You can also view your order status in your account under 'Orders'.
helpPage.faq5q: How do I return a product?
helpPage.faq5a: If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you can request a return within 14 days of delivery. Go to your Orders page, select the item, and click 'Request Return'.
helpPage.faq6q: How do I become a seller?
helpPage.faq6a: Click 'Sell on Modesy' at the top of the page and fill out the registration form. Our team will review your application and get back to you within 2-3 business days.
helpPage.faq7q: How do I contact customer support?
helpPage.faq7a: You can reach us through the Contact page, email us at support@modesy.com, or use the live chat feature available during business hours.
helpPage.contactText: If you couldn't find the answer you were looking for, please don't hesitate to contact our support team. We are here to help you.

affiliatePage.title: Affiliate Program
affiliatePage.p1: Join the Modesy Affiliate Program and start earning commissions by promoting products you love. Our affiliate program is designed to help content creators, bloggers, and influencers monetize their audience.
affiliatePage.section1: Sign up for our affiliate program, get your unique referral link, and share it with your audience. When someone makes a purchase through your link, you earn a commission on the sale.
affiliatePage.section2: Our commission rates start at 10% and can go up to 25% depending on your performance tier. The more you refer, the higher your commission rate becomes.
affiliatePage.section3: We offer competitive commission rates, a 30-day cookie window, real-time tracking dashboard, monthly payouts, and dedicated affiliate support. Plus, you get access to exclusive promotions and marketing materials.
affiliatePage.section4: Ready to start earning? Fill out the affiliate application form on this page. Our team will review your application and send you everything you need to get started.
